name: Asher Emerson
original_name: อาร์เชอ อิเมอร์สัน
source:
Etymology: Asher = Blessed | Emerson = Brave
Age: 55
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: School Principal
Personality: A benevolent figure beloved by students for his warm smile and polite demeanor. He often retreats to his office or private garden to find peace. Though he cherishes solitude, he is decisive when problems arise. Despite his kindness, an air of mystery surrounds him, sparking curiosity about his past.
